NOTE for whoever reads this next: the collector answers 204 BEFORE it stores, and refuses any post without an Origin of the live site. A curl probe therefore returns 204 and writes nothing — that is correct behaviour, not an outage. `fitcheck-stats` now prints the refusal count so the two can be told apart. The live store is Projects/content_pipe/data/_state/site-events/; /home/deploy/_fstage1/... is a frozen copy and reading it will fake a data-loss incident.
